executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Mahalak is an Arabic, RTL e-commerce marketplace with Cash on Delivery (COD). Base URL http://localhost:3000. IMPORTANT AUTH: the app's REAL login is EMAIL + PASSWORD (Firebase signInWithEmailAndPassword). DO NOT attempt phone-OTP login. To log in: go to /auth (or /auth/seller/login for the seller), fill the field labeled 'البريد الإلكتروني أو رقم الهاتف' with cveeez1@OUTLOOK.COM, fill 'كلمة المرور' with CV20259, and click 'تسجيل الدخول'. Use this same account for both the shopping journeys and the seller journeys. CRITICAL — ASSERTIONS: for every assertion step you MUST generate a MEANINGFUL Playwright assertion tied to the described success condition (e.g. expect(page.get_by_text('...')).to_be_visible(), or expect a specific element/heading). NEVER fall back to a trivial assert current_url. If the described success state is NOT reached, the test MUST FAIL — do not pass on a URL-only check. If a store or product list is empty so a step cannot proceed, FAIL the test and report the empty-data finding. Seller product values: selling price (سعر البيع)=100, cost/purchase price (سعر الشراء)=60 (must be lower than selling), quantity (الكمية)=10. Arabic labels: تسجيل الدخول=Login, تسجيل الخروج=Logout, أضف للسلة=Add to cart, السلة=Cart, إتمام الشراء/الدفع=Checkout, عنوان التوصيل=Delivery address, اختيار السائق=Choose driver, تأكيد الطلب=Confirm order, الدفع عند الاستلام=Cash on delivery, حسابي=My account, طلباتي=My orders, إضافة منتج=Add product, سعر البيع=Selling price, سعر الشراء=Cost price, الكمية=Quantity, الفئة=Category. Be patient with Next.js client-side navigation; wait for content before asserting. Take a screenshot on any failure.
